name: C1 Security-agency compliance kit: quarterly MVD report, weapons and special-equipment register, 5-day status notices
buyer: Licensed private security organisations (kuzet), including small agencies with armed guards, plus their branches
trigger: From May 2026 quarterly report by email to the MVD police department's security-activity control unit by the 25th after quarter-end, 13 data blocks (organisation and branches, training centre, service weapons and special equipment, protected school/preschool objects, police cooperation, employee offences, dismissals for negative reasons, terrorism-vulnerable objects). Dec 2025 Mazhilis-passed amendments: notify within 5 working days of suspension, resumption or work outside registered place; surrender weapons for storage if suspended; 5-year control shooting.
evidence: https://mybuh.kz/news/okhrannye-agentstva-budut-sdavat-otchety-v-mvd/ (dated 19.05.2026; order number, effective date and penalties not stated in article); https://bes.media/amp/tokaev-podpisal-zakon-ob-uzhestochenii-pravil-dlya-ohrannih-organizatsiy-v-kazahstane/ ; https://www.inform.kz/ru/v-kazahstane-ne-uchteno-oruzhie-800-ohrannih-kompaniy-deputat-e894d2 (about 800 firms' weapons unaccounted, per a deputy, unverified date)
existing: Competitor search in Russian ('программа для охранного агентства учет оружия отчет МВД ... софт') found no Kazakh vendor product, only legislation pages. Absence is not proof; 1C and security-company back-office tools not checked.
unchecked: Order number and in-force date of the reporting rule; penalty for missing the report; count of licensed agencies (licence register); whether the report form is a fixed template; whether 1C or an MVD portal already covers it; cleaning and manpower agencies not screened.

first_check.duty: Law signed in February 2026 amending the security-activity law (Z000000085). Search summaries give it as No. 263-VIII of 12.02.2026; bes.media, dated 12.02.2026, confirms the signing but not the number. Duties: report to the authority; notify the territorial police within 5 working days of a suspension, resumption or work outside the registered place; hand weapons and ammunition to the police for storage when suspended. The quarterly report goes by email to the MVD police security-control unit by the 25th after quarter-end, with 13 data blocks (mybuh.kz, 19.05.2026). The MVD order number and form were not confirmed: two fetches of zakon.uchet.kz, including candidate act V2600038906, timed out. Penalty not found. Order No. 83 of 09.02.2026 set up the MVD Committee for control of security activity (bizmedia.kz).
first_check.market: Sources disagree on the count: 5,129 private security organisations and 97,116 licensed guards (inbusiness.kz / 24.kz); about 4,500 registered (Senate report); about 4,200 operating, of which 800 have suspended work (a deputy, per inform.kz). In Almaty, 283 of 581 are active and 66 hold service-weapon permits (kapital.kz, undated). So the reachable market is roughly 3,000 to 4,000 active firms, and only a minority have weapons.
first_check.competitor: No Kazakh vendor or 1C configuration found for security agencies. A search summary of the inform.kz article (fetch returned 403) says an MVD information system called "E-kuzet" is in pilot in all regions. Per that summary, stage 1 digitises trained guards and stage 2 adds reporting tools, which could absorb the core job. Two direct searches for E-kuzet found nothing, so this is unverified. Today the report is plain email, with no portal.
first_check.reason: The duty is real. A law signed in February 2026 (No. 263-VIII per a search summary; bes.media dated 12.02.2026 does not give the number) requires security organisations to report to the authority, notify within 5 working days of a suspension or resumption, and hand in weapons when suspended. mybuh.kz (19.05.2026) describes a quarterly email report with 13 blocks, due by the 25th. The MVD order number, its in-force date and any penalty could not be confirmed. No vendor product turned up. The risk is an MVD system called "E-kuzet", which a search summary of an inform.kz article (fetch blocked) says is in pilot, with reporting tools planned for stage two. The market is about 4,200 to 5,129 organisations. The report is a simple email template, so willingness to pay is likely low.

challenge_check.killer: None found. The real risks are that Excel plus email is good enough and that a still-unverified MVD system (E-kuzet) could take over reporting.
challenge_check.reason: Nothing I found kills it. I found no Kazakh product, 1C configuration or MVD portal that does the job. E-kuzet still can't be confirmed: two more searches in Russian and Kazakh found nothing. The 5-day notice duty is confirmed as a risk criterion in inspection checklists: joint order MVD No. 389 / MNE No. 67 (June 2026). The market is real: about 4,200 active firms (800 more suspended), or 5,129 registered. The case is weak, though. The quarterly report is a 13-block email submission an office worker can fill in Excel. I found no penalty for missing it and no order number for the reporting rule. Inspections may be the stronger driver, and the pull to pay for software looks low.
